Its primary metric, Joint Success Function, requires the generated tests to fail on the initial program state, accept every valid candidate, and reject every invalid candidate. Across fourteen baseline coding agent configurations, Joint Success Function reaches only 28.00%, whereas single reference success reaches 59.67%. Our analysis reveals missed behaviors, unsupported assertions, and faulty test construction. To address these weaknesses, we introduce TestHelix, which combines heterogeneous synthesis of test and repair pairs with peer cross validation and recursive self improvement (RSI). Across two models, TestHelix improves Joint Success Function by 8.67 to 9.00 percentage points over the native harness comparators in the TestHelix evaluation

title: SparseEngine: Sparse-First Inference Engine
abstract: Long-context LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that strain KV-cache memory and attention computation. Although sparse attention reduces these costs, heterogeneous cache representations and workflows hinder integration with existing inference engines, while prior sparse-serving abstractions support only specific layouts or workflows. We present SparseEngine, a ground-up, sparse-first inference engine whose shared lifecycle contract lets each method control its KV representation and computation while coordinating state transitions with common serving infrastructure. SparseEngine supports 15 methods across four categories and enables cross-request state management through Chain Cache, which resumes KV-eviction methods from retained history, and controllable Prefix-Cache Pruning, which removes KV from selected history regions while preserving logical-prefix matching. While maintaining method quality, SparseEngine delivers over 10x higher throughput with KV eviction, over 2.5x faster decoding at matched concurrency than vLLM, and over 2x end-to-end speedup on agent benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/SparseEngine.

title: mlflow/mlflow v3.17.0
abstract: MLflow 3.17.0 includes several major features and improvements. ### Major New Features - **[Jev Decisions Across Evaluation, Gateway, and Tracing](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/scorers/llm-judge/custom-judges/typesafe/)**: Use TypeSafe models in built-in scorers and custom judges with typed Boolean or categorical feedback. (#26100, @B-Step62) - **[Fine-Grained Permissions for Shared Resources](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/security/role-based-access-control/#sub-resource-tiers)**: Control access to contained resource types, including runs, traces, and versions, with wildcard grants and explicit DENY. (#26157, @rrrkharse) - **[Faster Analytics for Large Trace Datasets](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/architecture/backend-store/#trace-analytics-daily-rollups)**: Reduce SQL analytics query overhead with opt-in daily summaries and raw-query fallback. (#25991, @HumairAK) - **[Clearer Evaluation Results](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/datasets/)**: Associate aggregate logged-model evaluation metrics with the managed dataset that produced them. (#25927, @joshuawong-db) - **[Assistant Improvements for Shared Servers](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/getting-started/try-assistant/)**: Keep saved conversations scoped to the signed-in user and reset the active session when accounts change. (#26009, @kriscon-db) **Database upgrade:** SQL-backed servers require a coordinated schema upgrade with all writers stopped and a restorable backup, even when daily rollups remain disabled. Run `mlflow db upgrade ` before restarting all replicas on the new MLflow version. Mixed-version rolling upgrades are not supported. Follow the [database upgrade instructions](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/architecture/backend-store/#upgrading-a-database-with-trace-analytics-data). ### Other Assorted Features & Improvements: - [Tracing / UI] Add rich rendering for TypeSafe System One traces (#26276, @B-Step62) - [Build] Show issue-triage progress in a GitHub issue comment (#26454, @copilot-swe-agent) - [Docs / Evaluation] Allow custom `base_url` for direct TypeSafe judges (#26445, @B-Step62) - [Docs / Gateway] Allow custom `typesafe_api_base` for TypeSafe Gateway endpoints (#26442, @B-Step62) - [Evaluation / Tracking] Support `name IN (...)` filters for evaluation-dataset search (#26374, @HumairAK) - [Docs / Evaluation / Gateway / UI] Support TypeSafe and OpenRouter Jev judges through Gateway System One (#26243, @joshuawong-db) - [Build / Docs / Tracing / Tracking] Add `@mlflow/typesafe` tracing integration for TypeSafe AI (#26342, @B-Step62) - [Build / Docs] Publish Helm charts after stable release images (#26064, @joshuawong-db) - [Tracing / UI] Add `TraceImage` to custom trace views (#26297, @chris-chieu) - [Tracing] Simplify tracing setup defaults in `setup.sh` (#26341, @B-Step62) - [Build / Docs / Tracing / Tracking] Add TypeSafe SDK autologging support (#26129, @B-Step62) - [Tracing / Tracking] Expose OTLP ingestion metrics for Prometheus (#25192, @ashtarkb) - [Tracing] Compute LLM trace costs client-side for SageMaker tracking (#26178, @B-Step62) - [Model Registry / Models] Add `uc_model_service` UC model-version dependency support (#26140, @TomeHirata) - [Models] Add `DatabricksUCModelService` resource type (#26137, @TomeHirata) - [Docs / Tracing / Tracking] Maintain SQL trace analytics daily rollups (#25489, @NeriCarcasci) - [Docs / Tracing / Tracking] Serve trace analytics reads from opt-in SQL daily rollups (#25239, @NeriCarcasci) - [Gateway / UI] Add TypeSafe Jev support to the AI Gateway (#26048, @xq-yin) - [Tracking] Support `order_by` in `search_prompts()` across the client, fluent, and GenAI APIs (#25967, @avanish-garg) -
